author: Padranas
quote: Piss poor attempt at a grand theft auto title, forces cutscenes and missions upon you, that you don't agree with, and if you skip them you miss out on story context as well as the constant stream of explicit cutscenes in which this installment is leaning heavily into, feels more like a gooner game than a grand theft auto title. This game feels more like it's for lonely single loser men, rather than the usual playerbase. Stealing cars and some other mechanics aren't as intuitive as could be, as well as the doubling down on physical copies not containing discs, so that if you want a refund for the game, you aren't able to receive one. I understand that this was stated before it's release, but let this be a warning to others to not make the same mistake of trying to get the game cheaper like I did, as you'll have wasted £64.99 on a game you don't agree with. This game is a huge disappointment, and to me a failure to the grand theft auto franchise as it takes away free choice in certain missions or skipping of cutscenes/story. Save your money and buy something that isn't gooner bait and doesn't rely on sex to appeal to men. This is coming from someone who has played since GTA IV and only missed the ragdoll physics that could've been in 5 and just wanted that for the sixth installment.
